title: The Truth about American Cities - Part 1 - Strong Towns [ST01]
summary: The first video in Not Just Bikes' Strong Towns series explains the financial instability of North American cities, based on Strong Towns research. It argues that low-density suburban growth costs more to maintain than it brings in.
why: HN people recommend it as the best introduction to why sprawl and car dependence are fiscally unsustainable, often pointing to the whole series.

quote.text: A good introduction on that part is the strong towns playlist by the youtube channel Not Just Bikes
